items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: after Charley and I and Elman got together, we said, 'Look, we're not making the money we should make... Let's break up this thing and go back East.'

ctx.x: Tell you the reason why, because I've got my wife out there. // See, and I'm trying to run a harem on the side, see, so anyhow, what happened, she told me, at last I let her talk. I'd been stopping her from talking because I thought she was trying to put her hand in my pocket, see. So, anyhow, I let her talk and she told me the setup that was happening. Well after Charley and I and Elman got together, we said, "Look, we're not making the money we should make. And we're out here and if we get into any trouble,…
I see. Now, before we leave Detroit, I just wanted to ask you what was going on in Detroit at that time, musically?
